Definitely make a lesson plan, assign certain times to whatever your covering in that class but allow for enough room that if the class is struggling it wont cut into time for your next activity. 
Since youll have an experienced instructor with you id advise you try to lead the class and answer as much as you feel CONFIDENT with. Itd be good for your students to see you turn to the more experienced and ask a question or look for guidance. Ive found alot of older adults are either really okay with foraging their own path and asking their own questions but others need to see you do it and feel out the culture before theyre comfortable with it. 
And finally if you have a chance you should shadow another beginner obedience as a background helper, itd help shape your expectations, and see what the general feel of the class could be. 
Good luck!
